chunks.text: The Automation Social Media project is a web platform designed to automate logging into and interacting with social media platforms (Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Twitter). It supports desktop browsers and antidetect browsers like GemLogin.

The project follows Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles implemented within Clean Architecture layout. Domain layer defines pure entities and contracts. Application layer defines ports and use cases. Infrastructure implements adapters.

The Browser Automation Management system is responsible for dynamic driver resolution, antidetect profile orchestration, browser lifecycle safety using Python context managers, and log monitoring with error screenshots.
